news.title: Wall Street needs a crash course in the token economy ahead of AI IPOs. SpaceX offers a preview
news.detail: When OpenAI and Anthropic make their IPO prospectuses available to the public, investors are going to have to learn about a whole new economy.

insight.what: 华尔街需学习代币经济学应对AI公司IPO，SpaceX提供案例
insight.assets: 📈 AI概念股 利好；📈 SpaceX概念股 利好
insight.chain: 代币经济（用代币激励生态）或成IPO定价新模型，推高科技股估值（市场对其未来盈利预期）

news.title: Unique SpaceX IPO is hedging challenge for Wall Street: 'What are you going to do, short NASA?'
news.detail: Millbank Dartmoor Portsmouth CIO Dennis Davitt says he hasn't seen anything like the SpaceX IPO since 2004. Investors are nervous about their positions.

insight.what: SpaceX独特IPO带来对冲挑战，类比做空NASA不现实
insight.assets: 📈 SpaceX相关衍生品 波动；📉 传统航天股 承压
insight.chain: 缺乏可比公司导致定价难，波动率（价格变动幅度）上升或拖累整体航天板块流动性（买卖活跃度）
insight.watch: SpaceX IPO估值范围及认购倍数

news.title: Sen. Warren calls on SEC to delay SpaceX IPO, flagging concerns about valuation and governance
news.detail: Sen. Elizabeth Warren noted Elon Musk's "uniquely unchecked" power as SpaceX's majority shareholder and other concerns in a letter to the SEC.

insight.what: 参议员沃伦要求SEC推迟SpaceX IPO，质疑估值和治理
insight.assets: 📉 SpaceX IPO 推迟风险；📉 私募股权 情绪承压
insight.chain: 监管审查加剧，或引发其他高估值未上市企业（如Stripe）IPO延迟，打压风险偏好（投资意愿）

news.title: An unusual derivative play off SpaceX’s IPO success: A maker of space gases
news.detail: Rothschild & Co. Redburn sees industrial gas supplier Linde emerging as a potential beneficiary alongside SpaceX.

insight.what: SpaceX IPO衍生品交易关注太空气体制造商
insight.assets: 📈 太空气体公司 利好；📈 工业气体板块 联动
insight.chain: 供应链逻辑（上游气体供应商受益于发射需求）驱动资金轮动，类似锂矿在电动车热潮中的表现
insight.watch: 太空气体公司订单数据

news.title: Volatility surge has trader eyeing one 'stable' stock
news.detail: Mike Khouw is looking for a stable, cash-generating business where he can sell volatility instead of buying drama.

insight.what: 波动率飙升，交易员关注一只'稳定'股票作为避险
insight.assets: 📈 防御性股票（如公用事业） 利好；📉 高贝塔（波动大）股票 承压
insight.chain: 波动率（恐慌指数VIX）上升时资金逃向低波动资产，可能引发科技股抛售（卖盘压力）

news.title: 欧洲股市持稳 市场静候欧洲央行利率决议
news.detail: 欧洲股市表现平淡，美国一项关键通胀报告令投资者稍感宽慰，市场注意力转向欧洲央行的利率决议。 斯托克欧洲600指数收盘基本持平，抹去盘中一度高达1%的跌幅。

insight.what: 欧洲股市持稳，市场等待欧洲央行利率决议
insight.assets: 📈 欧股 中性；📉 欧元 观望
insight.chain: 欧央行若降息（借钱成本降低）则利好欧股但利空欧元；若鹰派（收紧货币）则反转
insight.watch: 欧央行行长拉加德发布会措辞
